claims.summary: Over F2, for every m>n>=0, the Boolean rank equations AB=I_m admit an explicit Hilbert-like IPS certificate built with one shared child of shape (m-1,n-1), first-nonzero pivot selectors and all Boolean mux/field corrections. Size obeys S(m,n)<=S(m-1,n-1)+poly(m,n), and depth O(n); joint placeholder degree is at most 3^n(n+1)!. Normalization gives a full residual certificate of polynomial size and depth O(n), with no constant-depth guarantee or original-PC-degree preservation. A seven-fixture native Singular checker verifies all local matrix/field maps and negative controls.
claims.assessment: Working explicit shared recurrence and complete Boolean certificate ledger passed by the sole medium reviewer. Direct Hilbert-like normalization additionally lies in the (m-1)-st power of the matrix-B ideal, so fixed-order B jets at B=0 vanish for large m; this is not a statement about arbitrary residual representatives. No new general rank-principle IPS upper-bound novelty claimed.
claims.rationale: Tests the actual pivot/gluing architecture and distinguishes genuine one-child sharing from an unjustified factorial expansion; growing depth still misses the goal.
claims.next_action: Test exact circuit-level cancellation in the normalized recurrence, retaining all Boolean cofactors and the size/depth ledger; do not infer full-class hardness from the chosen certificate.

claims.summary: For the exact shared-pivot Hilbert-like certificate C_(m,n), its Y_(n+1,n+1) coefficient is the Gaussian pivot-success function of the first n rows of A, hence the binary determinant function on that square submatrix. At m=2n this particular certificate polynomial has no polynomial-size uniformly fixed-depth binary arithmetic circuit, by the recorded determinant-function lower bound. This does not lower-bound other certificate representatives or the normalized Boolean residual Q obtained from C.
claims.assessment: Working exact coefficient induction and attributed determinant-function consequence, passed by the sole medium reviewer; not formal determinant equality or a general IPS lower bound.
claims.rationale: Identifies a verified depth obstruction for the chosen pivot certificate instead of mistaking a naive branch count for an obstruction to all sharing.
claims.next_action: Keep the full-certificate and normalized-Q gaps separate while testing a shallow complete residual construction or an all-representative obstruction.
